# Talk & Tool

> Talk & Tool is a free directory of browser-based calculators, converters, and developer utilities, plus practical how-to guides. Every tool runs client-side — nothing typed into a calculator is uploaded or stored. The catalogue is available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, and Polish.

Tool pages document what each calculator computes, the formula or method used, and answer common questions about it. Blog articles are practical, tool-adjacent how-to guides. Prices, ad placements, and account/login pages are not relevant to understanding the site's content.

## Docs

- [All tools](https://talkandtool.com/tools): Full directory of calculators, converters, and utilities, grouped by category.
- [Blog](https://talkandtool.com/blogs): Guides and tutorials related to the tools.
- [About](https://talkandtool.com/about-us): What Talk & Tool is and who publishes it.

## Popular tools

- [Percentage Calculator](https://talkandtool.com/tools/percentage-calculator): Percentages, percentage change, and what share one number is of another.
- [BMI Calculator](https://talkandtool.com/tools/bmi-calculator): Body mass index in metric or imperial, with the healthy range for your height.
- [Loan & EMI Calculator](https://talkandtool.com/tools/loan-calculator): Monthly repayments, total interest, and the real cost of a longer term.
- [Word Counter](https://talkandtool.com/tools/word-counter): Words, characters, sentences, and reading time as you type.
- [JSON Formatter](https://talkandtool.com/tools/json-studio): Format, validate, and minify JSON with clear syntax error messages.
- [Unit Converter](https://talkandtool.com/tools/unit-converter): Length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, time, and data.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://talkandtool.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of every page, including all language versions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://talkandtool.com/privacy-policy): Data handling, cookies, and third-party advertising disclosure.
